primary.desc: rod taper spigot (black connector, z 44..75 above the knob)
primary.why: the rod is the machine interface: tapered spigot + O-ring seats that plug into the steam outlet; every turned feature of the rod and the knob dome is coaxial with it

origin.definition: rod axis ∩ knob top face (annulus around the rod, facing the rod tip)

clock.desc: steel tube leaving the elbow (Ø6 segment between the sleeve O-ring and the bend) -> +X
clock.why: the tube exit is the only functional non-coaxial axis; the lever paddle flat is noisier than the scan noise floor (noise_paddle_back 0.035 vs knob top 0.019)

landmarks.name: rod tip end above knob top (z max near axis)
landmarks.tol_source: independent provisional-frame read (PCA frame, knob top z 12.2, rod tip 79.5); 0.5 = read resolution of that plot

landmarks.name: tube tip end is below the knob (z min)
landmarks.tol_source: provisional-frame zmin -45.6 minus knob-top z 12.2 (first spec had an arithmetic slip, -49.5; corrected before any gate); 1.0 = coarse side check

chk_scale.note: no calipers (scan-only, DECISIONS MEASUREMENTS): units assumed mm, scale unverified; re-run trigger: any caliper reading (>=3 ENV dims for a scale test)
